summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) with eleven members and per-member comments. botocore/args.py adds the EPRBuiltins import, makes _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept a None endpoint configuration (treated as no variant tags), and adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean. tests/unit/test_args.py gains TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 22 tests covering each behavioral criterion. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 59 passed; test_regions.py, test_client.py, test_endpoint.py 384 passed. Nothing committed. Not verified: black/flake8 are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting was checked only by hand. One pre-existing 82-column line in args.py (the S3 regional config error raise, around line 315) was left unchanged.
